notes: All 6 required web searches ran this time, plus 1 on Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors (7 total). Every name search returned results about other Johnsons (mostly Speaker Mike Johnson), none about Dusty Johnson; the Mike Johnson material was excluded. The Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act House version (H.R. 10538, sponsor Greg Casar) has cosponsors reported as Democrats (FastDemocracy lists Hoyle, Lynch, Tonko; Forkast says Ocasio-Cortez and nine other Democrats); no source shows Dusty Johnson co-sponsoring, but the official Congress.gov cosponsor list was not checked. The quoted column was read from his official site. An earlier partial check of his press releases (pages 1 to 3, 19 December 2025 to 22 July 2026) found no mention of AI. Hearing remarks and floor speeches were not specifically checked beyond these searches.
